response.overview: Alter Yellow is a series produced by CAV Brequigny. The concept is simple: Each episode has a cinematic genre (comedy, drama, thriller, etc.) but with one common element: the presence of a yellow camcorder in each episode. In this first episode, we follow a couple slowly falling apart because of the space a camera takes in the life of one of the two girls. This will create the dilemma: 'It's it or me!'
response.title: Alter Yellow - Jaune Passion
